news.title: DeKalb man uses online romance schemes to trick victims out of $356K
news.summary: A Stone Mountain man used fake identities and online relationships to defraud victims out of thousands of dollars, according to federal prosecutors.

news.title: Suspect in MARTA bus shooting on Thursday identified
news.summary: Police have detained one person following a shooting on a MARTA bus near Covington Highway in DeKalb County on Thursday evening.

news.title: Man found dead after shooting in Clayton County
news.summary: The Clayton County Police Department's Criminal Investigation Division responded and is looking into the incident.

news.title: Man shot, killed in Clayton County
news.summary: Officers were called to reports of shots fired on Riverdale Road near Interstate 285 at 10:30 p.m. on Thursday night.

news.title: Teen shot in head, second person wounded in DeKalb shooting
news.summary: A shooting on Timbers East Drive left at least two people wounded, according to neighbors, as DeKalb County police investigated an active scene Friday morning.

news.title: Stabbing reported at Douglasville restaurant and cigar lounge
news.summary: Douglasville police reported a stabbing at Fumee Restaurant and Cigar Lounge.

news.title: Man found dead, another seriously hurt after shooting in DeKalb County, police say
news.summary: Details regarding what led up to the shooting and all the individuals involved are still unknown.

news.title: Second suspect arrested in deadly Buford botched robbery, police say
news.summary: A second suspect is in custody following a deadly September robbery in Buford that ended in a triple shooting, Gwinnett County police said.

news.title: Alpharetta police investigate false swatting threat aimed at local schools
news.summary: Alpharetta police and Fulton County School Police responded to a early-morning threat reported Thursday.

news.title: GBI: Non-student shot near Fort Valley State University clubhouse
news.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation is assisting campus police with a shooting probe at Fort Valley State University.

news.title: Man shot multiple times on MARTA bus in DeKalb County after fight escalates to gunfire, police say
news.summary: During the fight, someone pulled out a gun and shot the victim multiple times, police said.

news.title: Murder suspect arrested while breaking into vehicles in Smyrna, police say
news.summary: The suspect was wanted for murder in connection with a shooting earlier this year.

news.title: GBI charges 5 inmates in connection with death at DeKalb County Jail
news.summary: Authorities have charged Amir Andrews, Dajuhn Bryant, Treonte Brintley, Messiah Hinson, and Jayden King in the death of 24-year-old David Addo-Wright.
